title: DBU Construction
description: dbu-construction.com zoominfo.com/c/dbu-construction-inc/358513059 DBU Construction, Inc. (founded 1998 — "DBU" stands for Directional Boring and Utility, Chichester, New Hampshire) is a specialty contractor focused on trenchless horizontal directional drilling (HDD) and underground utility construction, plus roads, water/sewer, excavation and drainage work. It started drilling for Verizon Telecommunications and now serves municipalities, state and federal agencies (including Pease Air National Guard Base), utilities and developers across six New Hampshire counties and Maine, with roughly $15–25M annual revenue and 11–50 staff. In 2008 Jessica Towne took ownership, making it a Women-Owned Business Enterprise (WBE) and, since 2011, the first WBE in New Hampshire to offer directional drilling (also DBE-certified).
